scenario: AITA for telling my sister that her beating breast cancer was not impressive and not inspirational? | Three years ago my older sister was diagnosed with breast cancer. She has since plastered it all over social media. I don’t mind it because I can choose to ignore it. But this holiday season she was insufferable. My breaking point happened when my dad who has been dealing with nerve problems was telling us how physical therapy wasn’t working for him and he will likely need to get surgery. I don’t know maybe what I said wasn’t the nicest way but I don’t think I was wrong in what I said.
